The normal platelet count and smear effectively rule out thrombocytopenia and platelet dysfunction, shifting suspicion toward a coagulation factor deficiency. REQUEST TEST: Prothrombin_Time

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal coagulation profile and platelet count, I suspect a qualitative platelet disorder such as Glanzmann thrombasthenia. REQUEST TEST: Platelet_Aggregation_Studies

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: ELISA Binding Assay: Platelet surfaces deficient in GIIb/IIIa receptors.

speaker: Doctor
text: The deficient GIIb/IIIa receptors confirm the diagnosis of Glanzmann thrombasthenia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Glanzmann thrombasthenia
